thread:
ashwin: CI image publish failing on main -> registry returns "manifest invalid: duplicate layer digest" during push after SBOM stage. Build had no code changes besides Dockerfile reorder. Anyone seen this?
ci-bot: build/12345 failed during push to registry.redwood.ai/redwood/service:pr-789
rachel: hmm, we had a Dockerfile change that moved SBOM generation after copy step — could change layer ordering. That can cause dedupe mismatch when sbom uses same digest but different mediaType.
dan: can you paste the buildx command and the exact error? quick triage: rerun with --progress=plain for logs?
ashwin: build command: `docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --push -t registry.redwood.ai/redwood/service:pr-789 .`
ashwin: log snippet:
```
#13 pushing manifest for linux/amd64
error: failed to push to registry: manifest invalid: duplicate entries for digest sha256:abcd1234... with different mediaType
```
rachel: that indicates the SBOM layer was added as both `application/sbom+json` and `application/vnd.redwood.sbom.v1` in different stages. buildkit may dedupe by digest but registry enforces single mediaType per digest.
ops-bot: note: registry creds rotated 2h ago — but 401 not seen in logs, so probably not auth.
dan: easy workaround: generate SBOM into a separate filename per stage or force different digest by adding a tiny metadata label in the SBOM step. also try `--no-cache` to avoid reusing old layer ordering for a reproducer.
ashwin: i'm going to try `--no-cache` + small sbom metadata tweak and rerun. tagging @rachel in case it intersects with your PR.
rachel: thanks, lmk outcome. if reproduces we should add a CI check to ensure SBOM mediaType stays consistent across stages. :thumbsup: 
ashwin: rerun started 10:24am — will post logs
ci-bot: build/12346 started (manual rerun)
ashwin: ok fixed by adding `--label sbom.v=1` to sbom stage. push succeeded. not a creds issue. creating small docard in eng-infra about SBOM mediaType gotchas.
rachel: nice. can we add a unit test to packer that validates mediaType? low effort.
ashwin: will open PR.
